question: Model the conditional quantiles (tau=0.1, 0.5, 0.9) of inflammatory marker IL-6 using relative abundances of 500 gut microbiome taxa. Apply centered log-ratio (CLR) transformation to the microbiome data (add pseudocount 1e-6 before log). Fit a separate QuantileRegressor (sklearn, alpha=0.05, solver='highs') for each quantile. Report taxa with non-zero coefficients at tau=0.9 that have a zero coefficient at tau=0.5, sorted by absolute coefficient magnitude descending.
